website_metadata.notes: Payments Bank — by RBI licence cannot accept term deposits. The official FD page (https://www.airtelpayments.bank.in/products/fixed-deposit) states the FD is offered 'in partnership with IndusInd Bank' and booked via the Airtel Thanks app; no own-issued rate table is published (deposit capped at the Payments Bank Rs.500-Rs.1,90,000 limit). Any rates shown belong to IndusInd Bank.

warnings: Payments Bank — does not issue its own FD product. FD page (rendered via Playwright, domcontentloaded) confirms IndusInd partnership and no own rate table. WebFetch returned 403 (WAF); Playwright networkidle timed out, domcontentloaded render confirmed no rate table present.
